name: Mai'Zoth

narrative.details:
Kurzen may be dead, but...that which drove him to evil still lives!  Through my studies I have discovered this: An Ogre Mage - Mai'Zoth - dwells in an Ogre Mound within the eastern mountains of Stranglethorn.  He is rumored to employ mind-controlling magic, and I am positive that he corrupted Kurzen.

If Mai'Zoth is allowed to live, then his evil may influence others, and may even cause another Kurzen to surface.

Kill him, and bring me his Mind's Eye, the artifact he uses to corrupt others.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Mind's Eye to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Aha! You've done it! You are a great force for good, adventurer, and may your strength never fade!

I will study this Mind's Eye and determine if it may be used for good. If not... then it must be destroyed.
narrative.requestItemsText: I give you my blessing. Mai'Zoth's strength is matched only by his evil.

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 33 to 46, 22,400 XP in all.

quests.name: The Second Rebellion
quests.objectiveText: Kill 15 Kurzen Jungle Fighters. Return to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp.

quests.name: Bad Medicine
quests.objectiveText: Bring 7 Jungle Remedies and 1 Venom Fern Extract to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp.

quests.name: Kurzen's Mystery
quests.objectiveText: Find the 4 tablets and bring their legends back to Brother Nimetz.

quests.name: Special Forces
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Kurzen Commandoes and 6 Kurzen Headshrinkers. Report to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.

quests.name: Colonel Kurzen
quests.objectiveText: Kill 6 Kurzen Elite, 4 Kurzen Subchiefs, and bring Kurzen's Head to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.

quests.name: Troll Witchery
quests.objectiveText: Bring 4 Skullsplitter Fetishes to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp.

quests.name: Mai'Zoth
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Mind's Eye to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp.
